title: BalanceDef

base_exp_table_id.description: EXP table (exp.*) for base levels. Its length sets the max base level (Exp).

stat_points_per_base_level.description: Stat points awarded on reaching a base level. Variable: base_level (the level just reached).

skill_points_per_job_level.description: Skill points awarded on reaching a job level. Variable: job_level (the level just reached).

starting_stat_points.description: Stat points a new character starts with.

starting_stat_value.description: Value every primary stat starts at.

max_stat_value.description: Highest value a primary stat can be raised to (by points, before equipment and buffs).

stat_point_cost.description: Stat points needed to raise a stat by one. Variable: stat_value (the stat's current value, before the raise).

progression.description: Stat point, skill point and level cap numbers.

min_damage.description: Lowest damage a hit that lands can deal.

max_damage.description: Highest damage a single hit can deal.

crit_multiplier.description: Damage multiplier on a critical hit, as a formula. Caster and t_ variables are allowed (e.g. 1.5 + luk * 0.005); a constant is fine.

combat.description: Damage and chance clamps applied after the combat formulas.

max_path_length.description: Longest path, in cells (steps), a search may return; a longer route counts as "no path".

max_nodes_expanded.description: Most nodes a single search may expand before it gives up.

movement.description: Limits on path searches (grid movement, ARCHITECTURE §4).

description: The root of content/balance.yaml: tuning numbers and small formulas that are not per-entity stats (ARCHITECTURE §6.5). A single set per game, so it has no id. Progression and combat code reads its numbers from here instead of hardcoding them.
